    Keyboard shortcuts

    Use Cmd instead of Ctrl and Option instead of Alt on macOS.

    Moving and selecting

    Shortcut Action
    Arrow keys Move the active cell.
    Shift+Arrow keys Extend the selection.
    Ctrl+Arrow keys Jump to the end of the filled run, the next value, or the table edge (Excel style). Add Shift to extend the selection.
    Tab / Shift+Tab Move right/left and wrap at row boundaries.
    Enter / Shift+Enter Move down/up; commit first when editing.
    Home / End Move to the first/last column in the row.
    Ctrl+Home / Ctrl+End Move to the first/last cell in the table.
    Page Up / Page Down Move by approximately one visible page.
    Ctrl+G Go to a row or cell (120, C120).
    Ctrl+A Select all.

    Editing

    Shortcut Action
    F2 or double-click Edit the existing cell value.
    Typing Replace the active cell and begin editing.
    Alt+Enter (while editing) Insert a line break inside the cell.
    Ctrl+Enter (while editing) Put the typed value into every selected cell.
    Esc Cancel editing.
    Delete / Backspace Clear cells, or delete whole rows/columns when they are selected.

    Rows and columns

    Shortcut Action
    Ctrl+Alt+↓ / ↑ Add rows below/above (as many as selected).
    Ctrl+Alt+→ / ← Add columns right/left (as many as selected).
    Ctrl+- Delete the selected rows, or columns when columns are selected.
    Ctrl+D Duplicate the selected rows just below.
    Alt+↑ / ↓ Move the selected rows up/down by one.
    Alt+← / → Move the selected columns left/right by one.

    File and clipboard

    Shortcut Action
    Ctrl+S Save.
    Ctrl+Z Undo.
    Ctrl+Shift+Z / Ctrl+Y Redo.
    Ctrl+C / Ctrl+X / Ctrl+V Copy / cut / paste.
    Ctrl+F Open find and replace.
    F3 / Shift+F3 Next / previous search match.

    Mouse

    Action Effect
    Wheel / Shift+wheel / horizontal trackpad swipe Scroll vertically / horizontally.
    Ctrl+wheel Change the font size.
    Drag the fill handle Continue values; hold Alt on release to swap continuing and copying.
    Ctrl+click an asset cell Ping the asset in the Project window.

    During an edit started with F2 or a double-click, arrow keys move the caret. During an edit started by typing, arrow keys commit the value and move to the adjacent cell.
